brands.evidence: Yes — Monzo is a real, fully regulated UK bank.
Revolut's standard UK e-money accounts, which use "safeguarding" rather than direct FSCS bank deposit protection.

client_claims.text: Monzo started out in 2015 as a prepaid card and spending app
Monzo received its full UK banking licence in April 2017
client_claims.note: Licence date not in the facts.

client_claims.text: Monzo Bank Limited is authorised by the PRA and regulated by both the FCA and the PRA
Eligible deposits held with Monzo are protected by the FSCS up to £120,000 per person
FSCS protection is £240,000 for joint accounts
client_claims.note: Joint account limit not in the facts.

client_claims.text: Monzo holds its own standalone banking licence and does not share it with another brand
Monzo offers a standard UK sort code and 8-digit account number, Direct Debits, standing orders, BACS/Faster Payments
Monzo offers arranged overdrafts, personal loans and Monzo Flex instalments
Monzo has no physical branches and support is managed through the app or a basic emergency web portal
Cash deposits at PayPoint or Post Office cost a small fee, or are free within monthly allowances on certain paid plans
client_claims.note: Deposit fees not covered by the facts.
